description: Has this TITP supervising or implementing organization in Japan had an administrative action published by ISA, and when? Look up by permit number (1708000404), plan certification number (1704019156) or organization name (exact after normalization; partial = candidates), optional prefecture. Returns listed, not_found_in_checked_records (not proof of no action; actions no longer published are not returned) or unknown, with type, date, reason as published, source file and as-of date.

certification_number.description: Technical intern training plan certification number, e.g. 認1704019156, 変認1809000128 or the digits

limit.description: Maximum number of actions per list, 1-100 (default 20)

name.description: Organization name as published (Japanese), at least 2 characters. Width, case, spaces and line breaks are ignored

permit_number.description: Supervising organization permit number, e.g. 許1708000404 or 1708000404

prefecture.description: Optional filter: prefecture of the published address (Tokyo or 東京都), JIS code (13) or local government code (130001)

name: titp_action_lookup

action_notice.description: Always pass on: the action is as published on the date shown; it does not mean the organization currently has problems.

action_date.description: Date of the action (YYYY-MM-DD), normalized from the published cell.

action_date_as_published.description: The published date cell as is (an Excel serial number or a Japanese-era date).

action_id.description: This service's id for the action.

action_type_ja.description: Action type as named by ISA (改善命令 / 認定の取消し / 許可の取消し).

action_date.description: Date of the action (YYYY-MM-DD), normalized from the published cell.

action_date_as_published.description: The published date cell as is (an Excel serial number or a Japanese-era date).

action_id.description: This service's id for the action.

action_type_ja.description: Action type as named by ISA (改善命令 / 認定の取消し / 許可の取消し).

official_check.description: Read first: confirm on the official ISA page listed here before relying on this answer.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

listed = an action matching by number or exact name is in the ISA files checked; not_found_in_checked_records = no match in the files checked (does not mean no action was taken; actions ISA no longer publishes are not returned); unknown = not loaded, stale, a file unreadable, or candidates only.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Look up published TITP administrative actions
